PREPKIN CANVAS — PAGE PLAN

6 tabs: Home, Focus, Games, Learn, Friends, Shop. Each column is one tab; screens below it are its sub-pages.

Economy rule: coins pay for FINISHING things (tasks, focus, lessons, the daily word) — never for grades or correct answers.

Already working in the iOS build: everything except Versus, stories, and real friends (those need the M2 sync bridge).

Open questions:
- Does the weekly summary auto-post as your story?
- Do Canvas tasks auto-check when submitted?
- Chibi art style (these blobs are placeholders)

HOME
Greeting + coins. Chibi front and center (tap = wave, task done = bounce). Upgrade button. This-week stats. Grade calculator entry. Today's tasks: Canvas + study + life, each with a coin reward.

Sub-pages: grade calculator (RogerHub-style sliders), weekly summary (share card), Canvas pairing (one-time setup with code for the Chrome extension).

FOCUS
Focus Friend-style. Pick minutes, chibi naps while you work. Finish = 1 coin per minute. Give up = no shame, no pay. Running state hides the tab bar.

GAMES
Daily Word: one word a day, +30 once, daily leaderboard with friends. Versus: turn-based word battles (Words-with-Friends-style) — locked until friend sync (M2).

LEARN
Microlessons in tracks: personal finance, philosophy, study skills. 3–5 swipe cards, ~2 min, +20 coins on finish, once per lesson.

FRIENDS
Stories row (daily wins: focus streaks, solved words, finished lessons). Weekly coin leaderboard. Friends list with statuses. Add by code/link. All needs the M2 bridge — mock data until then.

SHOP
Chibi species grid: buy with coins (300–500), starter slime free, 3 levels each (Lv1→2: 100, Lv2→3: 250). Switching active chibi is free. Later: accessories / room items.
